mapper.sql: r.id,r.code,r.name,r.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.role_id=r.id) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE ur.role_id=r.id AND r.status='ENABLED' AND u.status=1 AND u.must_change_password=FALSE) AS usable_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id=rm.menu_id AND m.type='PAGE' WHERE rm.role_id=r.id) AS page_count

SELECT FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id WHERE ur.role_id=#{roleId} ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id WHERE ur.role_id=#{roleId}
SELECT rm.menu_id FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id=rm.menu_id AND m.type='PAGE' WHERE rm.role_id=#{roleId} ORDER BY rm.menu_id LIMIT 1001

SELECT m.id AS menu_id, COUNT(DISTINCT rm.role_id) AS role_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status='ENABLED' THEN rm.role_id END) AS active_role_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ur.user_id) AS user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status='ENABLED' AND u.status=1 AND u.must_change_password=FALSE THEN ur.user_id END) AS eligible_user_count FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id=m.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=rm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE m.type='PAGE' AND m.id IN #{id} GROUP BY m.id

SELECT DISTINCT rm.menu_id,u.id,u.username,u.nickname,u.status,u.must_change_password,u.locked_until FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id=rm.menu_id AND m.type='PAGE' JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=rm.role_id AND r.status='ENABLED' JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=rm.role_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE u.status=1 AND u.must_change_password=FALSE AND rm.menu_id IN #{id} ORDER BY rm.menu_id,u.id LIMIT 10001

SELECT rm.menu_id,COUNT(*) AS source_count,SUM(CASE WHEN r.status='ENABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_source_count FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id=rm.menu_id AND m.type='PAGE' WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY rm.menu_id ORDER BY rm.menu_id LIMIT 1001

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND rm.menu_id=#{menuId}) AS source_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND rm.menu_id=#{menuId} AND r.status='ENABLED') AS active_source_count FROM sys_user u ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
